intended_object: The subring obtained from a non-unital subring of a (non-associative) ring R that contains 1. It has the same carrier, and the extra fact 1 ∈ S supplies the unit axiom. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition keeps every field of the non-unital subring S (carrier, closure under addition, multiplication and negation, and zero membership) and adds `one_mem'` from the hypothesis `h1`. That is exactly how a non-unital subring containing 1 becomes a subring. The ambient assumption is `NonAssocRing R`, which is the same generality in which Mathlib defines `Subring` (`structure Subring (R) [NonAssocRing R]`), so nothing is narrower than it should be. The lemmas proved right after it (`Subring.toNonUnitalSubring_toSubring` and `NonUnitalSubring.toSubring_toNonUnitalSubring`) show that it is inverse to the forgetful map. This declaration is itself the Mathlib construction, so there is no separate counterpart.
